syntactic_simplification: Mice are key in neuroscience research. They offer a flexible model for scientists. Researchers can control and study them to learn about the brain. Historically, researchers preferred male mice for experiments. This preference is partly due to concerns about female hormone cycles. These cycles may cause behavioral variation and affect results.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important in brain research. They provide a useful model for scientists. Researchers can control and study them to understand the brain. In the past, researchers favored male mice for tests. This choice is partly because of worries about female hormone changes. These changes can cause behavior differences and affect results.
paraphrase_or_explanation: Mice are important in studying the brain. They are a helpful model for scientists because they can be easily managed and observed. Researchers choose to work with them to understand how the brain works. In the past, scientists often preferred male mice for their experiments. This was partly because they were concerned that hormonal changes in female mice could lead to differences in behavior. Such differences might mess up the test results.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important for studying the brain. They are useful because scientists can easily manage and observe them. Researchers use them to learn how the brain works. In the past, scientists often chose male mice for experiments. This was partly because they worried that hormonal changes in female mice could cause behavior differences that might affect the results.
